title_en: Rideflux registers 100th patent for autonomous driving technology
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Rideflux, an autonomous driving software company, has completed registration of its 100th patent and is accelerating its efforts to secure intellectual property rights (IP) for commercialization of level 4 autonomous driving. Rideflux announced on the 12th that it is developing technologies for overall autonomous driving software, including recognition/positioning, judgment/control, precision guidance, and remote operation, and is expanding its patent portfolio focusing on related technologies. The 100th patent registered this time is real-time LiDAR. It is an artificial intelligence (AI) technology that generates precision maps that automatically maps geometric elements such as lanes and curbs using data. It is a technology that reduces the cost and time required for construction by automating the manual labeling required in the existing precision map production process. Ride Flux explained that it was registered as a patent in recognition of its novelty and inventive step compared to the prior patents of Baidu in China and Deep Map in the United States. Ride Flux holds patents for cognitive technology that increases the processing speed and accuracy of the LiDAR-based object detection AI model, judgment technology designed to explain the driving judgment process, and road network map generation technology for real-time route planning. title_en: Banks offering high-interest special deposits and savings accounts one after another
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] As the stock market fluctuates and customer deposits fall to the low 100 trillion won range, banks are offering special deposit and savings products to attract customers. As of the 10th of this month, according to the Financial Investment Association, customer deposits were 100.718 trillion won, down 3.4884 trillion won from the previous trading day (7th). As deposits, which were once 110 trillion won in August, have decreased, the industry is expected to have either invested in stocks or moved to other assets. Domestic banks are taking advantage of this opportunity to introduce deposits and savings that offer higher interest rates than in the past. Jeonbuk Bank launched ‘The Dream Special Deposit’. The interest rate is around 3.70-3.80% per annum. NH Nonghyup Bank launched the ‘NH Nongshim Cheonsim Deposit’, a one-year maturity deposit with a limit of 300 billion won. The basic interest rate is 3.15% per year, and if you add up to 0.55%p of the preferential interest rate, you can receive a maximum interest rate of 3.70% per year. The subscription limit is over 1 million won. 'NH Nongshim Cheonsim Savings', which offers a maximum annual interest rate of 8.15% upon deposit, is also sold with a limit of 10,000 accounts. The maturity is 1 year, and you can sign up for up to 300,000 won per month. Woori Bank has launched ‘Our Wish Term Deposit’. There are two types of products with maturity of 6 months and 1 year, and the base interest rate is 3.40% per year based on 1 year.

title_en: ‘Naver Zone’ operated at NC Dinos home stadium… Tickets are NFTs

The place operated as a Naver Zone has 196 table seats in Section 117 of Changwon NC Park, the home stadium of the NC Dinos, and a dedicated line allows quick entry. In addition, Naver is the first to introduce NFT wallet-based NFT tickets (art) to NC Dinos home games for the first time in Korean professional baseball. Game tickets can be purchased from the banner in the Naver Sports baseball section or the reservation page among the 'NC Dinos' search results starting at 3 p.m. on the 13th. Customers who reserve tickets can purchase tickets through Npay simple payment and enjoy the benefits of accumulating and using Npay points. title_ja: 世界初の太陽光救急車の話題… 「一日最大715km走行」
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]オランダのアイントホーフェン工科大学の学生たちが電力網が届かない遠隔地域で現場医療サービスを提供できる太陽光駆動救急車を公開したと科学媒体ニューアトラスが最近報じた。ステラジュバはすぐにアフリカで実際の医療環境を対象に現場テストを進行する予定だ。電力網と医療インフラが不足している遠隔地域で自立的に医療サービスを提供する移動式診療所を目指して開発された救急車だ。 23人の学生で構成された研究チームは、厳しい環境でオフロード走行に必要な動力を供給するとともに、洗練された医療機器まで安定的に作動させることができる技術の開発に焦点を当てた。このために太陽光車に使われるシステムを超えて新しい設計を適用した。中国太陽光メーカーアイコ（AIKO）が生産したこの高効率太陽電池は、すべての電気接点を電池裏面に移し、前面の格子線。
title_en: The world's first solar-powered ambulance... “Drive up to 715km per day”
summary_en: [ZDNet Korea] Science media New Atlas recently reported that students at Eindhoven University of Technology in the Netherlands unveiled a solar-powered ambulance that can provide on-site medical services in remote areas without power grids. The name of this vehicle is ‘Stella Juba,’ and it claims to be the world’s first solar-powered ambulance. Stella Juba will soon be field tested in real medical environments in Africa. Stella Juba is different from highway ambulances that quickly transport patients to city emergency rooms. This ambulance was developed with the goal of being a mobile clinic that independently provides medical services in remote areas lacking power grids and medical infrastructure. The research team, comprised of 23 students, focused on developing technology that could provide the power needed for off-road driving in harsh environments while also operating sophisticated medical equipment reliably. To this end, a new design that goes beyond the system used in solar vehicles was applied. The core of Stella Juba is the ‘All Back Contact’ type advanced solar cell panel. This high-efficiency solar cell, produced by Chinese solar manufacturer AIKO, moves all electrical contacts to the back of the cell, leaving a grid line on the front...

summary_en: Microsoft (MS) plans to unveil its self-developed next-generation AI accelerator ‘Maia 300’ this fall and significantly expand production starting next year. According to The Information on the 9th (local time), MS plans to officially unveil Maia 300 as early as September. It is also discussing ways to secure production capacity of more than 300,000 chips with Taiwan's TSMC for supply in 2027. Microsoft plans to expand Maia 300 production capacity to more than 1 million units in the long term.
